hero.name: Mael Belhacene
hero.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
hero.typingLine: I align security with reality: governance, compliance, and operational defense.

about.p1: IT Security Assistant at DOMPLUS Groupe (work-study) and student in a Bachelor's in Systems & Network Administration at CESI, I'm building a dual-skill profile: cybersecurity and IT infrastructure management.
about.p2: I started in development (lead developer on internal projects) before moving into security, which gives me a hands-on grasp of both worlds: I know what a developer can break, and how a system gets hardened.
about.p3: Proactive by nature, I focus on the continuous improvement of internal processes with a pragmatic approach to technical and organizational challenges.
about.p4: Goal: pursue a Master's in IS Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Management, to grow as a cybersecurity engineer.

items.title: Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
items.description: Enforcement of internal (ISSP) and external (GDPR) policies, aligned with CNIL and ANSSI frameworks. Participation in security committees and third-party risk management (vendor monitoring and control).

items.title: Operational security & defense
items.description: Rollout of defensive measures (EDR/XDR), system hardening, access and attack-surface management. Incident handling in direct coordination with the Orange Cyberdéfense SOC.

items.title: Awareness & the human factor
items.description: Designing and running awareness sessions, managing phishing campaigns to strengthen internal vigilance.

items.title: Secure development
items.description: Building web applications (Laravel, Node.js) with a security-by-design approach, API integration and workflow automation.

jobs.title: IT Security Assistant
jobs.subtitle: Security Project Manager
jobs.description: Ensuring compliance and security posture (GRC). Enforcing ISSP/GDPR policies (CNIL, ANSSI), taking part in security committees and vendor control, running awareness and phishing campaigns, leading the EDR/XDR rollout, acting as IT point of contact and coordinating with the Orange Cyberdéfense SOC.

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure & Security Administrator
jobs.description: System operations and hardening. Improving stability and high availability, deploying secured solutions, managing access and reducing the attack surface. Transition toward governance missions after mastering the technical foundations.

jobs.title: Project & Application Manager
jobs.description: Sage X3 ERP rollout (report design, data migration, critical modules). Security-by-design Laravel/Node.js web apps. Built a ticketing platform from scratch, integrated via API (EasyRedmine). Owned the software lifecycle, from requirements to production.

jobs.title: IT & Cloud Technician
jobs.description: Cloud Hosting team. SSL certificate renewal process, full IT asset inventory, exposure to hosting and availability challenges (AWS).
